overview: FSHQ.gg Business Logic & Calculation Functions specification defines all core business operations, CRUD functions, validation rules, and mathematical calculations required for the Fantasy Sports Clubhouse platform. This specification covers user authentication flows, league connection and sync operations, membership management, role-based access control, commissioner content lifecycle, pick'ems submission and grading logic, engagement metrics calculations, and data synchronization workflows. All functions specify clear input/output contracts, data store changes, validation rules, and business constraints to enable direct implementation. Functions focus on WHAT operations need to happen rather than HOW to implement them, providing complete specifications for building a robust fantasy sports community platform with automated content generation, real-time engagement tracking, and multi-league support.

userRegistration.purpose: Create new user account with email/password authentication via Supabase Auth
data_store_changes: INSERT into users table via Supabase Auth
INSERT into user_preferences with default values
CREATE session tokens in Supabase Auth
business_rules: Email must not already exist in system (enforced by unique constraint)
Password must meet minimum strength requirements (8+ characters)
Verification email automatically sent after registration
User account created but not verified until email confirmed
Rate limit of 5 registration attempts per IP per 15 minutes
validation_rules: Email format validated against RFC 5322 standard
Password cannot contain only whitespace
Display name cannot contain special characters except hyphen and underscore
All fields sanitized for XSS prevention

userLogin.purpose: Authenticate user credentials and create session
data_store_changes: UPDATE users.last_login_at timestamp
CREATE new session in Supabase Auth
UPDATE user_preferences if rememberMe flag changes
business_rules: User must have verified email to login (configurable)
Failed login attempts increment counter for rate limiting
After 5 failed attempts from same IP, enforce 15-minute lockout
Remember me extends session to 30 days instead of 1 hour
Session tokens stored in httpOnly cookies for security
validation_rules: Email and password must not be empty
Credentials validated via Supabase Auth signIn
Session validated before returning user data
All failed attempts logged for security monitoring

createLeague.purpose: Create new league by connecting external fantasy platform league and performing initial sync

input_parameters.name: userId
input_parameters.description: Authenticated user who will become initial admin

data_store_changes: INSERT into leagues table with external_platform and external_league_id
INSERT into league_settings with default values (visibility=private, join_rule=approval_required, fan_access_enabled=true)
INSERT into league_memberships with role=admin, status=approved for creator user
INSERT into url_slugs with generated unique slug
INSERT into teams table for each team from external platform
TRIGGER initial sync job creation in background queue
business_rules: League ID must be valid and exist on external platform
External league cannot already be connected to FSHQ (check by external_league_id + platform)
User who creates league automatically becomes admin with full permissions
Unique URL slug generated from league name with collision handling (append numbers if needed)
Initial sync fetches: league metadata, teams, current season matchups, roster data
If sync fails, league record preserved but marked as connection_failed for retry
validation_rules: External league ID validated by calling external platform API
League must have at least 2 teams to be valid
Season and team_count extracted from external platform data
User must be authenticated to create league
Rate limit of 10 league creations per user per hour

updateLeagueSettings.purpose: Update league visibility, join rules, and feature settings (admin only)
data_store_changes: UPDATE league_settings table with new values
UPDATE leagues.updated_at timestamp
business_rules: Only users with admin role can update league settings (verified via RLS policy)
Changing visibility from private to public makes league discoverable
Changing join_rule from auto_join to approval_required affects future join requests only
Disabling fan_access prevents new fan role assignments but doesn't affect existing fans
Settings changes logged in audit trail for accountability
validation_rules: User must be admin of the league
League must exist
All enum values validated against allowed values
At least one setting must be changed

requestJoinLeague.purpose: Create membership request for user to join league with role and optional team claim

input_parameters.name: teamId
input_parameters.description: Team to claim if role is manager

data_store_changes: INSERT into league_memberships with status=pending or approved based on join_rule
UPDATE teams.claimed_by_user_id if team claim auto-approved
business_rules: If league join_rule is auto_join, membership automatically approved with status=approved
If league join_rule is approval_required, membership created with status=pending
User cannot join league they are already member of (prevent duplicates)
Manager role requires teamId parameter, fan role does not
Team claim validation: if sleeperUserId provided, verify it matches team's external_roster_id owner
Invalid team claim creates pending membership for admin manual review
Admin notified of pending memberships requiring approval
validation_rules: User must be authenticated
League must exist and be accessible (public or user has invite)
If role is manager, teamId must be provided and team must exist in league
Team cannot already be claimed by another user
Fan role only available if league fan_access_enabled is true

approveMembership.purpose: Approve or reject pending membership request (admin only)
data_store_changes: UPDATE league_memberships.status to 'approved' or 'rejected'
UPDATE league_memberships.approved_by_user_id with admin user ID
UPDATE teams.claimed_by_user_id if manager membership approved with team
INSERT notification record for user about approval/rejection
business_rules: Only admins can approve/reject memberships
Membership must be in pending status to be processed
Approval grants user access to league based on their requested role
Rejection removes membership request but preserves record for audit
User notified via email and in-app notification of approval/rejection
Approved managers automatically linked to their claimed team
validation_rules: Admin user must have admin role in the league
Membership must exist and be in pending status
If approving manager with team, verify team still unclaimed

createCommissionerDraft.purpose: Create new draft content for commissioner desk for specific week
data_store_changes: INSERT into power_rankings table with status=draft
INSERT into matchup_predictions table with status=draft (if predictions section not skipped)
INSERT into commissioner_desk_sessions for tracking
business_rules: User must have admin or designated commissioner role
Cannot create draft if published content already exists for week (must edit published instead)
If copyFromPreviousWeek=true, initialize rankings with previous week's order and matchup structure
All content sections default to empty/unpublished state
Draft creation logged with timestamp and creator user ID
Autosave begins on any edit to draft content
validation_rules: User must be commissioner or admin
Season and week must be valid for league
League must exist
No existing draft for this league/season/week combination

autosaveDraft.purpose: Automatically save draft content changes every 30 seconds or 3 seconds after user stops typing
data_store_changes: UPDATE power_rankings content and updated_at
UPDATE matchup_predictions content and updated_at
UPDATE commissioner_desk_sessions.last_saved_at
INCREMENT version number for optimistic locking
business_rules: Autosave triggered every 30 seconds while user active in editor
Debounced save triggers 3 seconds after user stops typing
Partial/incomplete content allowed in draft state
Version number incremented on each save for conflict detection
If save fails due to network error, queue for retry when connection restored
Offline changes stored in browser localStorage and synced when online
validation_rules: User must be creator of draft or have admin role
Draft must exist for the specified week
Content structure validated but completeness not required for draft

publishWeeklyContent.purpose: Publish completed commissioner content atomically, creating feed moments and updating pages
data_store_changes: UPDATE power_rankings.status to 'published' and set published_at timestamp
UPDATE matchup_predictions.status to 'published' and set published_at timestamp
INSERT into feed_moments for each published content type (separate moment per type)
UPDATE commissioner_desk_sessions with publication status
business_rules: Power rankings must include all teams with unique ranks 1-N if not skipped
Matchup predictions must reference valid matchups for the week if not skipped
Featured matchup must be one of the predicted matchups
Commentary fields have 500 character max length
Single publish action updates all pages and creates all moments atomically (transaction)
If any part of publish fails, entire operation rolls back to preserve draft
Published content creates separate feed moments for rankings, matchup, and predictions
Skipped sections do not create feed moments or validate content
User must be commissioner or admin to publish
validation_rules: All non-skipped required fields must be complete
Power rankings: no duplicate ranks, all teams included
Matchup predictions: all matchup IDs must exist and be for correct week
Content structure validated against schema
User has publish permissions

submitPickems.purpose: Submit or update user's pick'ems predictions for week's matchups

output_data.lockedPicks: array of matchup IDs that were already locked

data_store_changes: UPSERT into pickems_entries for each pick (update if exists, insert if new)
UPDATE pickems_entries.updated_at timestamp
SET pickems_entries.locked_at when matchup lock time reached
business_rules: Partial submissions allowed - user can pick only some matchups
Picks can be updated before matchup lock time (per-matchup lock based on game start)
Picks cannot be created or modified after individual matchup has locked
Lock time is per-matchup, not per-week (different games lock at different times)
Attempted edits to locked matchups are rejected with specific error
User can pick any team in the matchup as predicted winner
Picks stored immediately, no 'submit' required - each selection auto-saves
validation_rules: User must be league member (any role: admin, manager, fan)
Matchup IDs must exist and be for specified week
Predicted winner team ID must be one of the two teams in the matchup
Matchup must not be locked when pick submitted
User cannot pick for matchups after lock time

gradePickems.purpose: Grade completed matchups against user picks and update leaderboards

input_parameters.name: matchupId
input_parameters.description: Grade specific matchup, or all if not provided

data_store_changes: UPDATE pickems_entries.is_correct based on matchup winner
UPDATE pickems_entries.graded_at timestamp
UPDATE pickems_leaderboard_stats with new correct/incorrect counts
RECALCULATE leaderboard rankings and accuracy percentages
business_rules: Grading only occurs after matchup is completed and winner determined
Stat correction window: matchups monitored for 72 hours after completion
If stat correction changes winner, picks are automatically re-graded
Grading triggered by scheduled cron job every 2 hours during season
Manual grading can be triggered by admin for specific matchup
Only matchups with finalized scores are graded (not provisional)
Leaderboard updated atomically after all picks graded for fairness
validation_rules: Matchup must have final winner determined
All pickems_entries for matchup must have locked_at timestamp
Winner team ID must be one of the matchup teams
Grading idempotent - can be run multiple times safely

addCommentToMoment.purpose: Add user comment or reply to feed moment
data_store_changes: INSERT into comments table
INCREMENT feed_moments.comment_count
UPDATE feed_moments.last_activity_at for engagement bumping
INSERT into notifications for moment author and parent comment author
business_rules: User must be league member to comment
Comments immediately visible to all league members
Comment adds to moment's engagement metrics, may trigger feed promotion
Parent comment must exist and belong to same moment if replying
Moment bumped to top of 'recent' feed sort when commented on
Author can delete own comment within grace period (24 hours)
Admins can delete any comment (soft delete to preserve thread structure)
validation_rules: User authenticated and league member
Moment must exist and user has access to it
Comment text not empty after trimming whitespace
Comment text sanitized for XSS
Parent comment validation if replying

addReaction.purpose: Add emoji reaction to moment, comment, or transaction
data_store_changes: INSERT into reactions table with unique constraint on (user_id, reactable_type, reactable_id, emoji)
INCREMENT reaction count on target entity
UPDATE last_activity_at for engagement bumping if moment
business_rules: User can only add each emoji once per entity (prevent spam)
User can add multiple different emojis to same entity
Reactions contribute to engagement metrics for feed promotion
Reactions immediately visible to all league members
User can remove own reaction by clicking emoji again (DELETE)
Reaction aggregation shows total count per emoji type
validation_rules: User must be league member
Reactable entity must exist and be accessible to user
Emoji validated as single unicode emoji character
Duplicate reaction for same emoji returns existing reaction (idempotent)

promoteTransactionToFeed.purpose: Promote transaction to feed when engagement threshold reached
data_store_changes: INSERT into feed_moments with moment_type='transaction' and reference_id=transaction_id
UPDATE transactions.promoted_to_feed=true
SET transactions.promoted_at timestamp
business_rules: Promotion triggered when transaction engagement count exceeds threshold (default: 5 interactions)
Engagement count = comments + reactions on transaction
Once promoted, transaction appears in main feed with full transaction details
Promotion is one-way - transaction stays in feed once promoted
Threshold configurable per league in league_settings
Duplicate moments not created if transaction already promoted
validation_rules: Transaction must exist and belong to league
Engagement count must meet or exceed threshold
Transaction not already promoted (promoted_to_feed=false)
League feed moments enabled in settings

syncLeagueData.purpose: Fetch and update league data from external platform (Sleeper)
data_store_changes: UPSERT teams data (update if exists, insert if new)
UPSERT matchups for current week
INSERT new transactions since last sync
UPDATE team rosters and win/loss records
UPDATE leagues.last_synced_at timestamp
INSERT into sync_jobs table for tracking
business_rules: Full sync fetches all data from external platform (used on initial connection)
Differential sync fetches only changes since last sync (faster, used for ongoing updates)
Sync scheduled automatically: every 15 minutes during game days, hourly otherwise
Manual sync allowed by admins with 15-minute cooldown between requests
Stat corrections detected by comparing scores after 72-hour window
If stat correction changes matchup winner, trigger re-grading of affected picks
Sync failures logged and retried with exponential backoff
Partial sync failures preserve successfully synced data
validation_rules: League must exist with valid external_league_id
External platform API must be reachable
Sync job not already in progress for this league (prevent duplicates)
Rate limit respected for external API calls
Manual sync only allowed for admin users

input_parameters.name: season
input_parameters.description: Required for weekly and season scopes

edge_cases.result: accuracy_percentage = null, correct_picks = 0, total_picks = 0
only count graded matchups in calculation, indicate pending_picks count

edge_cases.condition: stat correction changed results after initial grading
edge_cases.result: recalculate with updated winner, correct_picks may decrease

calculatePickemsAccuracy.rounding_rules: Standard rounding to 2 decimal places (0.5 rounds up)

calculateLeaderboardRank.formula: rank = COUNT(users with higher accuracy) + 1, with ties handling

edge_cases.result: users with same percentage share same rank, next rank skips (e.g., 1, 1, 3, 4)
excluded from leaderboard or shown at bottom with N/A rank depending on scope
only users with matching role included, rankings recalculated for subset

calculateLeaderboardRank.rounding_rules: Ranks are integers, accuracy used for tie-breaking with 2 decimal precision

edge_cases.result: engagement_score = 0.0

edge_cases.condition: high comment count from single user
edge_cases.result: all comments counted equally regardless of author
check if engagement_score >= threshold to trigger feed promotion

calculateEngagementScore.rounding_rules: Score rounded to 1 decimal place, counts are exact integers

calculatePowerRankingsMovement.formula: rank_change = previous_week_rank - current_week_rank (positive = moved up, negative = moved down)

edge_cases.condition: team not ranked in previous week (week 1 or first appearance)
edge_cases.result: rank_change = null, movement_direction = 'new'

edge_cases.condition: team rank unchanged from previous week
edge_cases.result: rank_change = 0, movement_direction = 'same'
rank_change = null, previous_rank = null

calculatePowerRankingsMovement.rounding_rules: No rounding needed, ranks are integers

edge_cases.result: accuracy_percentage = null, counts = 0
only count completed matchups with determined winners

edge_cases.condition: stat correction changed winner after grading
edge_cases.result: recalculate accuracy with corrected winner

calculateStreakLength.formula: streak_length = COUNT(consecutive weeks with accuracy >= threshold), resets on miss

input_parameters.name: accuracy_threshold
input_parameters.description: Minimum accuracy to maintain streak (50% default)

edge_cases.condition: user did not participate in a week
edge_cases.result: streak broken, reset to 0
do not include in streak calculation, use most recent completed week
counts as meeting threshold, streak continues

calculateStreakLength.rounding_rules: Streaks are exact counts, no rounding

edge_cases.result: participation_rate = null, both counts = 0
calculate based on current submissions, indicate 'in_progress'
user counts as participant if submitted at least 1 pick

calculateWeeklyParticipationRate.rounding_rules: Rate rounded to 1 decimal place, counts exact
